bestBets.overview: SO SI GOD showed plenty of natural ability in his first preparation, starting with a debut win. This race lacks real quality, he's trialled well and William Pike rides. SESH is in career-best form. He will likely park off the speed and attack the line strongly late. SUNSET SESSION was sound last start at this track and distance. KINGS HONOUR should be peaking at his third run back from a spell.

raceTips.comment: Sunset Session is going really well and probably didn’t get the right run last start having to make his run back to the inside on a Heavy track when the brunt of the winners on that program were coming down the middle. Much better draw to work with here and gets back onto a drying surface here, not jumping off. Spanish Armada absolutely bolted in at Northam last start and could really take running down if let alone in front, maiden win of a horse with more in-store and this looks a nice set-up. So Si God is the upside resuming off the back of a slick trial leading in. Just wary the 1000m is going to be on the short side for her, she’s drawn widest in the small field and she’s likely to be very short all the way through betting. Nice horse and can win without surprise fresh. Kings Honour an improver with Nottle & shades on.

SUNSET SESSION was some sort of go in betting last start - $7 into $2.70 (deductions negligible) and ran alright behind Niccimota and Eternal Wine, both of whom progress to the 66+ 1000 whilst he drops back into a Westspeed Platinum. Has been going well all preparation and this does look a winnable race on paper for him. Likely to settle alongside main danger SO SI GOD who looked really stylish in a recent barrier trial and has already proven herself to be 60+ Grad quality. Think this is the preparation she can work her way through the grades but wary she’s not a natural 1000 horse and will jump short. SESH has just gone from strength to strength since a confidence boosting 46+ win at York a few months ago. SPANISH ARMADA is a tough on speeder.

bestBets.overview: NICCIMOTA attacks this off a dominant first-up win, parking wide throughout and still powering away from her rivals. The only query is that was a rain-affected surface. She will likely be back on top of the ground for this. EXCESS BAGGAGE has returned to racing in top form, hitting the line strongly in both her starts this time in. CANNYKEV is a lightly raced five-year-old who put together a very strong preparation last time in. His recent trial effort looked strong and he draws to get every chance in running. DAWN DANCER will lead and is the one to run down.

raceTips.comment: Think the gear change of Pike on and a drying surface can close the gap between Niccimota and Eternal Wine. She’s chased home super at her last two and while the fav had her measure last start, it was a Heavy deck and for the kind of horse that she is Pike should suit her down to the ground. Gets 1.5kgs in her favour to turn the tables as well, more than capable. Niccimota just keeps raising the bar! Huge win in conditions that probably favoured parking off the track in running yet still putting pay to them late. Have to be incredibly respecting of her off that and a deserving favourite yet…I still have trust issues? Even more favourable map from the draw this time around. Excess Baggage is flying but the 58.5kgs she’s made to carry here from near last in running could prove telling late? Not a big mare and could just take a bit of that powerful finishing burst she’s got out of her legs. Dawn Dancer can kick through to land on the bunny as she searches for 3 in a line, she’s very quick and seemingly only getting better! Good little race this.

DAWN DANCER won an all age maiden as a 2 year old taking on the older horses on 9 July at 1:47pm and then 47 hours later on 11 July at 12:48pm backed up into a 2 year old SWP and ran them ragged beating Morning Thunder (prior Saturday winner) and Spinarella (subsequent Saturday winner). She’s had a 6 week freshen and a very sharp 400m jump out in between and on the 55kg minimum of this race should be in front for a long way at an eachway quote (which should get better and better through betting). Why can’t she win? ETERNAL WINE has drawn awkwardly her last three (10/13, 10/10 & 8/10). This is the best barrier/map pairing she has seen in a while and Michael Lane books William Pike. Big respect. EXCESS BAGGAGE is flying and if she is only one pair further back than Eternal Wine on straightening it’s very much game on. NICCIMOTA got conditions to suit first-up and bolted in. Big win but this is harder.

bestBets.overview: WITH DISCRETION was turned over as an odds-on favourite last start but did have some excuses and it was a rain-affected track. Back on top of the ground I'm expecting him to bounce back to his best. If he repeats his effort of two starts back he takes a stack of beating. SWEET SURRENDER was enormous in defeat last week, parked wide throughout and only narrowly beaten. CHOLLIMA found the line last start and Harvey goes on. ROMMEO has claims if he can repeat his last-start effort.

raceTips.comment: WITH DISCRETION looked your typical Cerise and White progressive staying type when he went 7 days from a 1400 to a 2100 and made a mess of them. A fortnight later he struck a Soft7 (which was later downgraded to a Heavy8 and then a Heavy9) and he drew to settle three back fence – ugly. Complete forgive run and now back onto an improving surface expect he’ll bounce back with a vengeance. CHOLLIMA missed a run a fortnight ago so comes into this 4 weeks between outings but her effort behind With Discretion on 25 July was really encouraging. She’s ready to win. WARRALEA LASS can roll to the top in a race that is completely devoid of any speed / pressure. ROMMEO has been there abouts in this grade for a long time and got an overdue win on the board last start.

With Discretion went under as a $1.90 pop last start from barrier 1 on a Heavy track on a day where that inside pad was not where you wanted to be. The win prior to that was that of a horse that could put 2-3 together in this sort of company and think he is more than capable of bouncing back in a big way in this field, still progressing and the drying surface will only further benefit him as well. Warralea Lass should be able to lead and control here, run had plenty of merit in defeat last start on a day where leading probably wasn’t the recipe for success and she gets some handy weight swings on some key rivals she meets again. Chollima has missed a run but she was the best run of the beaten brigade behind With Discretion last start, may have found a new lease on life over these trips, going super! Sisu Spirit brings real X-factor out to the staying trip for the first time in his career, his previous two outings in midweek company have been very good and he’ll do no work in the run following the fence line cuddled up for a flying Lucy Fiore.

bestBets.overview: CINQUE STELLE is a very talented mare who attacks this off two super-impressive wins. She gives the impression the rise to 1600m will suit and if she holds form she wins again. HEAVEN SPECIFIED attacks this off a strong win over 1400m. He should appreciate the rise in trip and draws the inside gate. OUR MATE ARCHIE didn't fire over the 2000m. The drop back to a mile should suit and the blinkers go on. VEXATIOUS ROSE is rock-hard fit and racing well.

raceTips.comment: CINQUE STELLE could just be a really nice mare in the making. The market has taken a serious set against her in her last two outings and it just goes to show ‘the market doesn’t always know!’. After opening odds on last start she got out to $4 and beyond late in betting and after ducking back to the inferior inside part of the track simply blew her rivals to pieces. That was the win of a mare who would just keep winning and if she can show that same turn of foot at 1600m as she did at 1100 and then 1400 then she’ll be working her way into Open Class. HEAVEN SPECIFIED was brilliantly placed into a Westspeed Platinum last start by a very in form Trevor Andrews operation. Can lead if nobody else wants to. TRIPLE THE CHANT scratched from a winnable race Thursday to save for this. COSMIC WALTZ has returned in really good order.

Cinque Stelle has put her excuse riddled first up run aside and posted two performances since then that have suggested she’s a cerise & white mare going places. Drew inside on a day last start which it’s been well documented in this preview wasn’t the place to be (was a huge drifter in betting as a result), Pike did everything he could to get off that part of the track but he wasn’t left with any other option so he’s been made to make his run there and it ultimately did not matter one iota. The way she lengthened and put her rivals away was that of a black-type quality mare who has got proper gears. She’s out to a mile here, drawn perfectly to be put to sleep in behind the speed in a race that doesn’t possess a huge amount of fear factor. If she’s as good as she’s suggesting she might be, she’ll put these away again and make it 3 in a line. Heaven Specified dug deep to take out a very high-rating 3YO 1400m contest last start in what has already been a winner producing race. Can box-seat from 1 and should get every opportunity if good enough. Thought 1400m might’ve been past his limit re. distance range but I was wrong and won’t be the last time! Triple The Chant scratched from a very suitable race Thursday to save for this and she was much, much better last start. Mile her pet trip, she’ll be rattling late and looks a big place price at $4 pending where you shop?Vexatious Rose has put it all together now that she finally got that maiden win out of the way and gets some nice weight relief here from a plum alley.

bestBets.overview: GAINTREE found the line well in her only start and was immediately turned out for a spell. She's been tuned up with two strong trial wins and Pike rides. ROGUE RULER made his debut in a stakes race where he parked wide throughout on the speed and did a good job to hold on for third. He's been readied for his return with two trials, he draws a nice gate and the blinkers go on.  SPINARELLA attacks this off a tough last-start win and has claims again. PROPERATA is racing well and has claims.

raceTips.comment: ROGUE RULER ran well on debut behind Beatty and Consignment in the Crystal Slipper Stakes. With Beatty going on to win a Perth Stakes, finish second in a Karrakatta Plate and win a WA Sires Produce the form line is always going to be attractive and he now returns as a gelded 3 year old with a set of blinkers applied for the first time. Quite liked his recent trial and he looks like going around at double figures. Worth consideration fresh. GAINTREE missed a run with a hoof abscess a fortnight ago so headed back to Belmont trials Monday where she covered the ground effortlessly in a trial where the first two cleared out from rivals.

Gaintree looks a nice 3YO. Very quiet trial prior to her 2YO debut where she ran a cracker behind a flying Aurum Belle at the time before being tipped out. Was scratched when slated to return a couple of weeks ago and has been back to the trials since and thought it was a very strong hit-out under the double wraps in very quick time for the morning. Pike rides, lands in the first 4-5 in running from the gate and think she’s got more upside and ability than these. Properata was winding up strongly late last start over the 1000m when just unable to get to the stablemate in Spinarella, really solid effort and not only enjoys a weight swing but has some versatility. Chantatious has impressed at the trials for a powerful yard and a jockey riding as well as any here in WA at the moment, should get a lovely run. Manhattan Squeeze is a very honest filly who should run another very honest race with the run she’ll enjoy drawn the pole.

bestBets.overview: ASIF just missed first up over this trip. He improves off that run and draws to get every chance with Pike riding. LORD SHIVA is on the seven=day back-up after running his rivals ragged last Saturday. He will look to fire straight to the front again and give them something to chase. HEY PINO is rock-hard fit and racing well. SUNNY HONEY rolls forward and gives a sight.

raceTips.comment: LORD SHIVA left no stone unturned last weekend with a high-speed exhibition. They never looked like running him down at any stage of the race and he held them to a safe and comfortable 1.3L margin. 7 days later he drops 4kg in weight, draws to again lead and the only real X-Factor / unknown element is how they’re intending to ride King Adviso 6 weeks between runs. Hopefully they don’t cut at each other in the early/middle stages? ASIF is the likely big beneficiary if they do lock horns in a battle for the fence. Thought he had his chance fresh to run down Hey Pino and may have just peaked late. HEY PINO may have to drop out to last? Hurts. KING ADVISO’s best and worst are 20L apart. Not sure which version you’ll get.

Asif should be hard to beat here second up. Trialled super for his return and thought his run on return on that Heavy track at Belmont chasing home hard into 2nd behind Hey Pino was very good when just unable to pull back the margin late. Improves, sits closer here from 4, drying surface with Pike sticking in a race where they should really get along at a good gallop, ticks a lot of boxes for me. Lord Shiva made the leap to 1200m seven days ago with aplomb and gave none of his rivals a chance. Will look to do the same again here off the 7 day spin but this is certainly a few lengths deeper race but given I can’t see King Adviso or Sunny Honey having the early speed to take him on, should be able to lead and roll them into the corner which is where he’s at his best. Hey Pino has been racing at the peak of his powers for a while now and off his win last start where he held off the favourite late, isn’t showing any signs of stopping. Sunny Honey found the front and staved them all off last start, this is deeper and looks a trickier map but he’s tough.

bestBets.overview: Looking forward to seeing the return of last season's WA Guineas winner, KING OF LIGHT. He is a super-talented type who's been tuned up for his return with an impressive Lark Hill trial win. From a good draw he can stalk the speed and I think he should be too good for these. SNOWDOME has run well in his last two starts. He'll park on the speed and give a kick. FLURO NEURO is arguably in career-best form. He will be finding the line strongly. FINAL SIREN next best.
bestBets.suggestedBet: Keen on King Of Light, quaddie 9 only

raceTips.comment: KING OF LIGHT could be WA’s best horse. 2 from 2 undefeated as a 2 year old, 3 year old winner of a Belgravia Stakes, Fairetha Stakes and WA Guineas before suffering the first defeat of his life in the Group One WFA Northerly Stakes where he got knocked around by the big boys and had simply had enough. Couldn’t have trialled up any better for his return to racing and should be far too sharp and progressive for his older winter rivals. Has the profile of a horse who could jump $1.30/$1.32. SNOWDOME has been brave in defeat in the H.G Bolton and Belmont Newmarket and will land in a similar spot in running yet again. FLURO NEURO gets the majority of recent rivals better at the weights heading into WFA conditions and is always dangerous late with a soft run. GINGER BAKER ran third last year in this race off a near identical freshen.

The return of King Of Light is clearly the drawcard on a very thin Belmont Park Saturday program. With some huge ambitions this campaign, he makes his return off 2 recent trials all of which gave the impression that he’s humming behind the scenes at Morton Racing. Resumes under WFA conditions here which is clearly going to be a challenge for him early in his preparation but expecting he’ll be up for it and he’s really not bumping into any superstars or horses flying (bar maybe 1) in this line-up. Really excited to see what he can do this campaign and hopefully he announces with this performance that there are much bigger things in store for him, would only be good for WA racing. Snowdome is the horse I see as the only danger and the horse that King Of Light will have to get to late in the piece. His last two have been terrific and despite sitting over the speed he was the strongest through the line of the beaten brigade of those coming through the Belmont Newmarket last start. Perfect map to really challenge the favourite. Man Crush was very good the way he fought on in the Newmarket despite covering some extra ground in the run, much softer run and better suited here under the WFA conditions of the race. Fluro Neuro another suited by the race conditions but was a touch plain in the run to the line last start, sprint at this stage of his career may have come out of his legs a bit quicker than previously?

bestBets.overview: SEARCHIN' TIMES was disappointing last start then tipped out for a freshen-up. If she finds the form she displayed last preparation, when she posted four straight wins, she will be hard to beat. COMMON TOUCH posted four straight all-the-way wins before just battling away last start when he was unable to lead. If he can fire straight to the front and dictate terms he will be hard to run down. REFEMME NO ANGEL is racing well, draws the inside and has Pike going on. ROAMING AMERICA next best.

raceTips.comment: Searchin Times resumes off 7 weeks for Summer Dickson who, as we saw once again midweek, is the best in WA at presenting fresh ready to breathe fire on race-day. Classy mare who had to do a mountain of work the last time we saw her at the races and still thought the run was pretty good, gets Nottle on here who is 2/2 on-board her and this race just sets up beautifully for one sitting off the speed ready to strike late. Happy to bet. Common Touch was left wanting late after a searching speed battle last start, not dropping off him off one bad run, his runs prior to that were outstanding and if Lucy Fiore can get him across and into a spot he’ll take some beating if he’s holding his form. Doesn’t need to lead to win either. Refemme No Angel is no star but box-seating for Pike from barrier 1 is going to mean he’ll be there when the whips are cracking. Roaming American only improves here second run back.

SEARCHIN’ TIMES won her first four races for new trainer Summer Dickson progressing from a maiden to a C1 to a C3 to a 60+ Graduation in the space of 48 days. Didn’t get the right run in her 66+ attempt when the winning streak came to an end and then first-up earlier this campaign endured a torrid run from start to finish. Actually thought all things considered she still found the line alright and now 7 weeks later she’s back at the races again. If she gets in early, she’ll be hard to hold out late. COMMON TOUCH and ALLENTOWN went toe to toe from start to finish last start in a messy game of cat and mouse between riders. They’re drawn barriers 11 & 12 respectively here as they meet again. Who hands up? REFEMME NO ANGEL is Pike in the last on the day that he is inducted into the WA Racing Hall of Fame – iconic if he wins.
